compatibility.placement: standing feet registered; isolated handheld props; one authored view

production.method: built-in ImageGen with existing character reference; native-size independent sprites
production.prompt: Game asset, identity-preserving illustration. Use the single attached project character as the exact identity and brushwork reference. The same small rust-red kobold artisan, golden eyes and swept dark horns, long curved tail, wings with damaged membranes folded against the back, off-white sleeves, brown stitched leather work apron and belt vials. All anatomy and wing damage as in the reference. Produce one transparent RGBA game animation sheet at 1536 x 1024 or the highest available size in a 3:2 landscape aspect ratio. Exactly four equally spaced columns and two equally spaced rows, each cell one full-body drawing, read left to right on each row. No words, numbering, grid lines, floor, background, casting shadows, other characters, or panels. All eight cells strictly share one orthographic camera, body scale and view direction (match the attached facing, slight tactical elevation). Use the same eye level and vertical placement in all phases. Place each full-body silhouette at the center of its cell, keeping every hand, horn, wing, tail, clothing hem and foot at least 15 pixels inside its cell at this resolution. Shared foot baseline an equal distance from bottom of each row; character should fill about 79-83 percent of cell height. Strong readable silhouettes and finely painted cloth and skin without blown highlights. No graphic style shift or redesign. Eight visibly different phases of ONE grounded action in temporal order. A tinkering loop with a small brass gear held at her chest: 1 looks at gear, 2 holds steady in left hand, 3 brings a tiny screwdriver to the hub, 4 adjusts, 5 turns the gear partway, 6 checks it, 7 retracts the tool, 8 resumes the first pose. Distinct hand and elbow movement. Both feet on the ground, no airborne pose. The gear and tool are held and fully visible.

review.technical: Native detail, cell clearance and distinct PNG phases verified
